title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company Overview


At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview


Join the Missions & Insights organization and help us build the next generation of public safety technology. We create the platforms that power real-time emergency response, crime analysis, and critical capabilities like drone-as-first-responder and AI-driven situational awareness. Our work has a direct impact on saving lives and ensuring community safety. Our portfolio, which includes CommandCentral Aware and RapidDeploy, is expanding with cutting-edge innovations in autonomous incident detection and AI triage. Our goal is to create a mission-first, cloud-native, and intelligence-driven nerve center for modern public safety.

The Link Exchange team collects and normalizes telemetry data from a wide variety of sources, including many different device types, Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), and other Public Safety systems. This information is then intelligently consolidated and supplied to the end user, providing crucial insights for situational awareness.

Job Description


We are seeking self-motivated, enthusiastic engineers to help us design, develop, test, and deploy tools, and services for our SaaS products. Ideal candidates must be good at solving problems, have strong interpersonal skills that will lead to technical changes, and seek ways to improve our processes in innovative ways. Someone that will help us make architecture changes, including taking risks that will allow us to make our product more sustainable and maintainable so that we can invest our energy in implementing new features that will make us keep our current customers and will also allow us to gain new markets. To be successful in this role, you must value teamwork and communication as well as work closely with other engineers in small, dynamic, agile teams.

This team is responsible for providing data between PSAPS to enhance situational awareness within our application suite. This solution is a cloud-based, highly scalable suite of microservices that captures communicates between different PSAP CADs and applications. We work closely with several applications teams both inside and outside MSI to realize this vision and this solution is always evolving to raise the fidelity of the information we provide and our customers depend on the solution to keep first responders safe in moments that matter.

What you'll do

  • Perform microservice development using primarily Java as well as some front-end UI technologies and frameworks.
  • Code, build and test sophisticated digital experiences, services and cloud platforms.
  • Partner on the design and iterative development to enhance and support an effective, reliable and secure solution.
  • Interact cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Product, and QA teams.
  • Design approaches supportive of our multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Help convert functional requirements into technical designs addressing high-level business and use-case objectives.
  • Implement platform features in a cloud environment using cloud technologies and tools.
  • Develop and share industry and product technical expertise.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years' experience developing for highly scalable and available systems.
  • Eexperience in building frontend applications with React or Angular framework
  • Experience must include the following: Java, J2EE, Spring, HTML, CSS and JavaScript; Object Oriented Concepts, Data Structures, REST and/or SOA Services, Web technologies and internet protocols; knowledge of and SASS is a plus.
  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms, Azure preferred (AWS or GCP are also welcome).
  • Proficiency with cloud databases, cosmodb preferred (dyanmodb welcome)
  • Excellent practical knowledge of architectural and design patterns, open source platforms, technologies and software engineering methodologies.
  • API design & implementation experience.
  • Experience with Websockets/Server Side Events would be appreciated
  • Devops experience and interest maintaining build and release pipelines (github actions preferred)
  • Preferably UI development and engineering experience delivering front-end features.
  • Experience developing innovative solutions that meet organizational needs with respect to functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, realistic implementation schedules, and alignment to development goals and principles.
  • Experience working within the Agile development methodology.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills.
  • Preferably knowledgeable of the types of organization served by Motorola/Rave (state and local public safety, facilities / property management)
  • Advanced English - be able to communicate effectively in English (read, write and speak)
  • Knowledge of automation testing frameworks like Playwright.

Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como:segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos. Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas. Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação de compra dos materiais emergenciais para as clínicas, realizar as Cefalometrias e as fotos para realizar a documentação de Ortodontia dos pacientes, quando necessário. Realização de procedimentos básicos juntos aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomadas radiografias) sempre com supervisão do Dentista. title: Sales Account Executive
description:
About Us
Foundey(formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States.
We work alongside ambitious SaaS teams as long-term design partners, helping translate complex challenges into meaningful user experiences that support real business growth.
Our approach is embedded, focused on partnership and outcomes, rather than transactions.
While UX/UI is at our core, we support everything design-related — from product and web to motion, graphic design, and branding.
About The Role
We're looking for a high-ownership, consultative Account Executive to drive new business for Foundey.
This is an end-to-end sales role where you'll own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through discovery, strategic alignment, proposal development, and close.
You'll work directly with founders, product leaders, and engineering executives at fast-growing SaaS and AI companies.
Success in this role requires strong discovery skills, the ability to diagnose product and growth challenges, and comfort selling high-value design engagements.
This is not a transactional sales motion.
It requires both commercial sharpness and genuine empathy — someone who listens deeply, understands a founder's context and constraints, and builds trust through thoughtful, consultative conversations, not just pressure-driven tactics.
What You'll Do
Own and close B2B SaaS deals end-to-end, working with cutting edge startups to Series A/B organizations
Generate outbound pipeline and build opportunities from scratch
Sell SaaS, technology solutions, or tech-enabled services (especially UX/UI, but also graphic, web and motion design services)
Lead strategic discovery calls with senior decision-makers
Run compelling discovery calls and live working sessions, along with delivering executive-level presentations
Multi-thread deals across stakeholders
Drive negotiations with confidence
Maintain disciplined forecasting and deal control
Consistently exceed aggressive revenue quotas
What We're Looking For
Minimum 3+ years of B2B sales experience
Strong experience closing enterprise SaaS and/or Technology Solutions ? Bonus: UX/UI service deals
Proven, documented track record of exceeding quota
Experience selling to startups and scale-ups, especially within North America
Deep understanding of selling technology to product-driven companies
Native or fluent English (mandatory)
Exceptional closing, negotiation, and objection-handling skills
Executive presence and strong communication
Highly competitive, resilient, and performance-driven
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and early-stage environments
High ownership mindset with a drive to create impact
Must-haves
You have demonstrated closing opportunities from end-to-end
Take full ownership of achieving your quarterly quota / goals
You thrive in a high pace environment
Demonstrated the ability to close multi-threaded deals
Ability to work with multiple Buyer Personas - Founders, CEOs, CIO/CTO, VP of Engineering
Nice to Have - worked in a startup environment
Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.
You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.
How to Apply
If you're a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Personnel Logistics Analyst
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • As a Personnel Logistics Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the logistics of travel, visas, and when applicable, training and medical requirements for personnel across various domains, including Fleet, Project/Commissioning, or Installation. You will act as the primary point of contact for all mobilization, demobilization, and travel arrangements, ensuring seamless coordination with managers, agencies, or suppliers.

    • Responsibilities


  • You coordinate travel, visa, and when applicable, training, and medical requirements, for personnel, including staff, contractors, subcontractors, or vendors.
  • You serve as the central point of contact for all mobilization and demobilization processes, ensuring timely and efficient arrangements.
  • You liaise with relevant managers, such as crewing, commissioning, and installation managers, to align personnel logistics with operational needs.
  • You collaborate with external agencies, suppliers, and vendors to ensure compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements for personnel movements.
  • You maintain accurate records of personnel movements, ensuring all documentation is up-to-date and compliant with company policies.
  • You respond promptly to any logistical challenges or issues, providing solutions to minimize disruption to operations.
  • You monitor and report on the effectiveness of logistics processes, suggesting improvements where necessary.
  • You ensure that all personnel are briefed on their travel and mobilization plans and that they have all necessary documentation and equipment.

    • Education


  • Diploma in Business Administration

    • Experience


  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Secretary and/or in a travel organization or as Administrative Assistant.

    • Functional Competencies


    Calendar, Schedule, and Travel Coordination Document and Correspondence Management Logistics Office Applications Proficiency Business Partnering Third parties relation management Employment law Data collection and entry Troubleshooting Planning

    GENERAL INFORMATION

    SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

    SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.  All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Estagiário em Supply Chain
description:
*Resumo
Sobre a Enerflex *
A Enerflex é uma empresa global de soluções integradas para os setores de energia, com presença consolidada em mais de 20 países. Sediada no Canadá e com operações no Brasil, oferecemos expertise em engenharia, fabricação, instalação e serviços pós-venda para sistemas de compressão de gás natural, geração de energia e processamento de hidrocarbonetos. Comprometida com os mais altos padrões de segurança, inovação e sustentabilidade, a Enerflex atua com excelência em projetos que impulsionam a eficiência energética em todo o mundo.

Sobre a Oportunidade
Estamos em busca de jovens comprometidos(as) com o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional, que queiram iniciar uma carreira sólida em uma empresa referência no setor de Óleo e Gás. Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais em início de carreira que desejam trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto padrão técnico e oportunidades reais de crescimento.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ

*Principais responsabilidades e deveres *

  • Apoiar na condução de processos de compras de baixa e média complexidade, nacionais einternacionais;
  • Auxiliar no relacionamento com fornecedores e áreas internas para alinhamento dedemandas;
  • Contribuir com o mapeamento de oportunidades para redução de custos e melhoria deprocessos;
  • Apoiar na gestão e controle de materiais, além de realizar cadastros no sistema ERP;
  • Elaborar e atualizar relatórios e indicadores de desempenho da área (KPIs);
  • Apoiar o time em análises diversas e em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à área deSuprimentos.

*Qualificações *

  • Cursando graduação em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas;
  • Ter, no mínimo, 1 ano disponível até a conclusão do curso;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de urgência;
  • Proatividade, ética e disposição para aprender;
  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Inglês intermediário(leitura, escrita e conversação básica) – desejável;
  • Pacote Office – Nível intermediário (ênfase em Excel);
  • Power BI – Conhecimento básico será considerado diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão (ERP) – desejável;
  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

*Condições de Trabalho *

  • Local: Escritório no Centro do Rio de Janeiro – atuação 100% presencial;
  • Carga horária: 6 horas diárias (30 horas semanais);
  • Regime de contratação: Estágio;
  • Duração: 12 a 24 meses, conforme disponibilidade do estudante;
  • Relacionamento direto com o time de Suprimentos e interface com áreas internas e fornecedores;
  • Ambiente corporativo, colaborativo e com foco no desenvolvimento do estagiário.

Sobre nós:
Transformando energia para um futuro sustentável. A Enerflex é a principal fornecedora global integrada de soluções de infraestrutura de energia, abrangendo soluções de processamento de gás, compressão, geração de energia, refrigeração, criogênica, transição energética e água. Temos orgulho de empregar mais de 5.000 funcionários altamente qualificados em mais de 25 países em todo o mundo.

A Enerflex coloca seus valores fundamentais de integridade, comprometimento, criatividade e sucesso em ação em todos os aspectos do negócio. Nossa inovação, forte compromisso com a segurança e serviço superior aos nossos clientes nos posicionam como o parceiro ideal para atender às necessidades do dinâmico setor de energia.

Promovemos uma cultura de garantir que nossos funcionários tenham as ferramentas para realizar seu trabalho corretamente, mas também para prosperar em suas funções. Temos orgulho de nossos salários competitivos, extensos programas de recompensas, celebração do sucesso de indivíduos e equipes e estamos comprometidos em garantir que a Enerflex continue sendo um espaço seguro e inclusivo para todos.

A Enerflex é uma empregadora que oferece oportunidades iguais
A Enerflex concede oportunidades iguais de emprego a todas as pessoas qualificadas, independentemente de raça, cor, sexo, idade, nacionalidade, religião, informação genética, deficiência física ou mental ou qualquer outra característica protegida pela legislação federal, estadual ou local aplicável. Oportunidades iguais de emprego são oferecidas em recrutamento, contratação, promoções, salários, benefícios e outros termos, condições e privilégios de emprego.

Aviso de responsabilidade
As declarações acima têm como objetivo descrever a natureza geral e o nível do trabalho realizado pelas pessoas designadas para esse trabalho. Eles não pretendem ser uma lista exaustiva de todas as responsabilidades, tarefas, deveres, conhecimentos, habilidades e habilidades necessárias.

title: Accreditation Documentation
description:
Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accreditation Documentation & Content Management:

  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.

Training Material Development & Delivery:

  • Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.

Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination:

  • Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Brazil

description:
About CTI
CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services is a global, privately held, full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on the advancement of treatments for chronically and critically ill patient populations. We assist clinical research throughout the lifecycle of development, from drug concept to commercialization. CTI is headquartered in the Greater Cincinnati, OH region with global operations in collaboration with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device firms. For more information, visit
What You'll Do

Conduct site visits (pre-study (PSV), site initiation (SIV), interim monitoring (IMV), and close-out (COV)) and complete site visit deliverables with quality and within given timelines in Monitoring Plan while adhering to all applicable regulatory requirements, SOPs and ICH GCP

Conduct remote monitoring and complete the related activities in accordance with study specific Monitoring Plan
Utilize systems and reports to track subject status, subject case report form (CRF) retrieval / source document review (SDV), regulatory documents, and IP
Assist with project-specific activities as member of Project Team Monitoring Plan, etc.)
Participate in the development of CRFs and other study related documents (subject worksheets, Monitoring Plan, etc.)
Perform translation, customization, and review of Patient Information sheet and Informed Consent, protocol synopsis and other study applicable documents as per required procedures
Where applicable, provide support to Regulatory Affairs Study Start-up Team in the preparation or revision of documentation for submission to Ethics Committee(s), Institutions Ethics Committees, Regulatory Authorities, Competent Authorities or Institutions Administration Boards, and follow-up the evaluation process until approval is available. Provide regular updates to Sponsor/ Client
Where applicable, support in contract negotiation with study sites, Investigator payments and tracking of site payments
Manage ISF and TMF for all assigned study sites in accordance with SOPs or study-specific Monitoring Plans
Identify an anticipate site issues and implement corrective actions or escalate as appropriate
Liaise with Clinical Data Management for data cleaning activities
Serve as mentor/trainer for CRAs; may include conducting training/assessment visits
Function in the role of Lead CRA for assigned projects(s0
What You Bring
At least 5-8 years of clinical trial monitoring experience or equivalent experience as determined by CTI Management and Human Resources
Fluent in English

We support career progression – We have a structured mentoring program to provide the support you need to move forward

We think globally and act locally – We have a global philanthropic program supporting our team's efforts to improve their local communities (click here to learn more about our "CTI Cares" program)
We are looking toward the future – We have had a consistent double-digit growth rate over the last decade, invest in cutting-edge technology, and pride ourselves on our average 95% annual retention rate (a recent report found that the average turnover for CROs in the US was 30%)
Our work makes a difference – We focus our work on treatments for chronically and critically-ill patients, who are depending on us to bring these life-changing therapies to market

description:
Sobre a Bradesco Seguros

O Grupo Bradesco Seguros é um conglomerado segurador da Organização Bradesco que possui atuação multilinha em âmbito nacional nos segmentos de Seguros, Capitalização e Previdência Complementar Aberta, atuando com empresas que detém representatividade nos respectivos segmentos: Bradesco Seguros, Bradesco Saúde, Bradesco Auto/RE, Bradesco Vida e Previdência, Bradesco Capitalização e Mediservice.

Valorizamos as diferenças e entendemos que elas favorecem o crescimento pessoal e profissional, amplia a capacidade de entender e estimula o respeito à individualidade e privacidade do ser humano.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos sempre em busca de pessoas dispostas a aprender, que apresentem uma postura proativa e engajada na busca por soluções e que compartilhem dos mesmos valores que a gente.

·       Ensino médio completo ou em andamento;

No Bradesco valorizamos a saúde e bem-estar, oferecendo um extenso portfólio de benefícios a todas nossas pessoas funcionárias:

·       Remuneração compatível com o mercado

title: Expedidor
description:
Quer fazer parte de um time de sucesso?
Na Crane Worldwide Logistics, reconhecemos que nossa força de trabalho é nosso maior patrimônio.
A nossa abordagem flexível e dinâmica acompanhada da nossa proposta de valor agregado apresenta dedicação aos nossos clientes através da Tecnologia, Serviços e Pessoas.
Somos uma organização orientada para excelência no atendimento e que valoriza os colaboradores que demonstram um forte senso de urgência. Essential Job Functions
Manage full-cycle expediting from PO issuance until material delivery to final destination
Maintain proactive follow-up with national and international suppliers, ensuring alignment with client instructions.
Update and control timelines and status in Client system and internal controls, ensuring visibility and traceability at all stages.
Validate Commercial Invoice, Packing List, photos, fumigation and other required shipping documents according to the SOPs and checklists.
Request freight pick-up and coordinate with freight forwarders and customs brokers to ensure fiscal and documentation compliance.
Identify and address discrepancies among PO, CIPL, and MR (OSND).
Flag special requirements (Dangerous Goods, Repetro, Import License, oversized cargo) and apply correct procedures according to internal instructions.
Participate in meetings with suppliers, clients and internal departments to align priorities and solve critical issues.
Prepare expediting performance reports and indicators for assigned POs and Projects.
Other Skills & Abilities
Knowledge of customs, export and import processes is considered a differential that adds value to the role.
Proficiency in Excel; knowledge of Power BI is a plus.
Intermediate to advanced English for communication and document review.
Strong organizational skills, sense of urgency, and effective communication.
Ability to plan and prioritize tasks, manage critical projects, and perform effectively under pressure.
Education And Experience
Bachelor's degree
Proven experience in international expediting, supply chain, or import logistics.

title: TECNICO DE MANUTENCAO I
description:
O Grupo 3corações é construído por pessoas, antes de tudo, apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Temos orgulho de crescer pela força do trabalho e seguir, cada vez mais longe, sem esquecer a nossa essência e os nossos valores. É pelo nosso jeito simples de ser que celebramos a diversidade de pessoas e as experiências saborosas que entrelaçam histórias. O resultado é uma companhia com produtos de qualidade, colaboradores e consumidores felizes, fornecedores e parceiros integrados em uma mesma missão proporcionar experiências prazerosas que promovam alegria e bem-estar, criando laços duradouros e gerando valor para todos. Deguste um mundo de possibilidades na maior empresa de cafés do Brasil

Saiba mais em

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar atividades externas de manutenção preventiva/corretiva e instalações envolvendo avaliação das condições técnicas do local para o correto funcionamento das máquinas de café;
  • Realizar instalações e orientações de uso dos equipamentos do portfólio da companhia;
  • Cumprir os indicadores relacionados a área (quantidade e tempo de atendimento, reincidência técnica);
  • Realizar o controle e emitir relatórios periodicos referente as peças sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Cuidar da manutenção e conservação do veículo, ferramentas e peças sob sua responsabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

Escolaridade

  • Ensino técnico completo em eletroeletrônica, eletrotécnica, mecânica ou mecatrônica.

Necessário

  • Experiência anterior com assistência técnica e/ou manutenção;
  • Curso de NR 10 - Normativo para segurança em instalações dos serviços em eletricidades;
  • Possuir habilitação categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho de segunda a sábado;
  • Residir na região Sul Fluminense (Volta Redonda, Barra Manda, Angra ou proximidades)

Informações adicionais

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde compartilhado;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Transporte;
  • Refeição;
  • Kit de Produtos mensal;
  • Telemedicina e Terapia Online 100% custeadas pela empresa (estendido a dependentes);

O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho, valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor, que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser, inovador e empreendedor, nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integram o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, empenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores. Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho. Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Atuar como agente estratégico de inteligência organizacional, transformando grandes volumes de dados em informação clara, acionável e orientada à decisão, apoiando a AZ Gestão e seus clientes na melhoria contínua da performance, na definição de indicadores, no redesenho de processos e na tomada de decisões conscientes, sustentáveis e alinhadas aos princípios de excelência, integridade e inovação.

  • Responder pela qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho dos recursos, serviços e informações geradas pelas tarefas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos bens patrimoniais, solicitando manutenção, reparo e/ou reposição, sempre que necessário;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo
  • Excel Intermediário
  • Será um diferencial conhecimento no sistema Tasy
  • Ser organizado e proativo.

Informações adicionais

Sobre o processo seletivo:

Aqui na ViV, acreditamos que cada pessoa carrega uma história única, e queremos conhecer a sua. Nosso processo seletivo começa já no cadastro, como um convite para entendermos melhor sua trajetória, sua essência e sua conexão com a nossa cultura.

Na etapa seguinte, nosso time de Gente & Gestão entra em contato para uma conversa leve e acolhedora. Esse é um momento de troca: vamos falar sobre suas experiências, expectativas e o perfil da vaga, além de apresentar a ViV, nossos valores e o caminho do processo. Fique à vontade para tirar suas dúvidas, esse espaço é todo seu.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na ViV :

  • Conheça a ViV: entenda nossa atuação na área da saúde, nosso propósito e a forma como cuidamos das pessoas todos os dias.

  • Acompanhe nossos canais oficiais e redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre nossa cultura, valores e o jeito ViV de trabalhar.

  • Reflita sobre sua trajetória: pense nas suas principais experiências, aprendizados e conquistas, e como elas se conectam com a vaga.

  • Durante as conversas, compartilhe suas vivências de forma genuína. Falamos sobre resultados, mas também valorizamos os desafios enfrentados e os aprendizados ao longo do caminho.

Dica ViV: seja você. Compartilhe suas conquistas, aprendizados e desafios da sua trajetória. Valorizamos a transparência, o desenvolvimento contínuo e relações construídas com cuidado.

Desejamos a você um processo leve e uma ótima experiência com a ViV

Fundada em 2022, a ViV surgiu da união de importantes instituições de saúde mental, com o objetivo de criar uma rede interligada de cuidado, da baixa à alta complexidade. Hoje já somos mais de 1600 colaboradores e 900 leitos, estamos em 6 estados e nosso histórico de vidas transformadas está apenas começando. Já somos o maior grupo de saúde mental do país e temos o orgulho de poder atender a quem precisa, em diferentes etapas da jornada de cuidado, sempre com o mesmo objetivo: elevar a vida ao seu melhor

Estamos comprometidos em elevar a vida das pessoas ao seu melhor, por isso nossa rede de cuidados é o reflexo do que há de mais avançado em tratamentos psiquiátricos, com estrutura completa que inclui hospitais, clínicas e residências terapêuticas, todos interligados para proporcionar o melhor acolhimento aos pacientes.

Nós convidamos você a se tornar parte de uma equipe dinâmica e talentosa, onde poderá desenvolver suas habilidades e crescer profissionalmente. Na nossa empresa , valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a inovação e o compromisso com a excelência. Se você busca um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, com oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso time

Nossa missão é elevar a vida, cuidando da saúde mental do Brasil.

description:
IMPORTANTE: As pessoas interessadas deverão enviar carta de motivação, compartilhando o seu interesse em trabalhar na Empodera e currículo POR EMAIL para ******, com assunto "Coordenadora de projetos", até18/01/2026.Aquelas que não forem realizadas de acordo com essas especificações serão desconsideradas.
Vaga exclusiva para mulheres, cis e trans. A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres negras, indígenas, LBT e com deficiência.
A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para integrar nosso time e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.
Acoordenadora de projetos plenoserá responsável pela coordenação das atividades, cronograma, equipe e parcerias do projetoFuturos Seguros.
As atividades da coordenadora serão desempenhadas objetivando alcançar as metas e resultados no planejamento, implementação da metodologia e na execução das atividades do projeto, garantindo qualidade e alinhamento com a missão e cultura da organização.
Futuros Seguros é um programa exclusivo para adolescentes grávidas e jovens mães, moradoras de comunidades socialmente vulnerabilizadas no Rio de Janeiro.
Co-projetado com as participantes, o programa possui uma abordagem holística que, através do esporte, contribui para o seu desenvolvimento e empoderamento.
Quem somos
A Empodera –Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma organização, sem fins lucrativos, com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional.
Fundada em ****, desenvolve programas e projetos esportivos, com viés educacional, para meninas adolescentes e mulheres periféricas, e capacita organizações de todo o Brasil na criação de espaços seguros para meninas no esporte.
A Empodera é uma organização especializada em gênero e esporte e trabalha em prol do empoderamento de meninas e mulheres, em sua pluralidade, utilizando as práticas corporais e esportivas como ferramentas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades socioemocionais e a discussão de temas-chave para que as atendidas desenvolvam seu pleno potencial e exerçam os seus direitos.
Principais responsabilidades
GESTÃO DE PROJETOS (40%)
Planejar e coordenar com autonomia a execução das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e padrões de qualidade definidos pela organização;
Elaborar e executar estratégias de recrutamento de participantes e acompanhar a participação continuamente; e de mitigação de riscos;
Utilizar as ferramentas de comunicação e gestão de projetos da Empodera para o planejamento e atualização das ações do projeto;
Realizar relacionamento com parceiros locais e internacionais, assegurando cumprimento de prazos, entregas, relatórios e responsabilidades, e promovendo articulação e alinhamento estratégico;
Contribuir para a melhoria contínua das metodologias, oficinas, ferramentas de trabalho e estratégias de mitigação de riscos, propondo ajustes e soluções operacionais;
Realizar treinamentos sobre a metodologia do projeto e sobre espaços seguros e inclusivos para meninas e mulheres no esporte, onde serão abordados os temas: gravidez na adolescência, liderança, direitos, enfrentamento à violência contra meninas e mulheres, enfrentamento ao racismo e outras formas de opressão;
Apoiar estratégias de comunicação e divulgação dos resultados do projeto, garantindo visibilidade e sistematização dos aprendizados;
Participar em eventos e reuniões de articulação comunitária, em redes, workshops, conferências e congressos relacionados à temática dos projetos da Empodera.
GESTÃO DE PESSOAS E LIDERANÇA DA EQUIPE (35%)
Orientar e acompanhar a equipe do projeto, oferecendo suporte técnico, assegurando coerência metodológica e acompanhamento do plano de trabalho;
Liderar processos de feedbacks individuais, planos de desenvolvimento profissional e de compensação;
Apoiar processos relacionados à equipe, como recrutamento, desligamento, acompanhamento de ponto, de acordo com as políticas institucionais.
MONITORAMENTO, AVALIAÇÃO E PRODUÇÃO DE CONHECIMENTO (15%)
Elaborar, revisar e sistematizar relatórios, materiais didáticos e produtos de conhecimento, incluindo diagnósticos, artigos e guias de atividades, atuando com autonomia na consolidação das informações;
Desenvolver/adaptar o plano e ferramentas de monitoramento e avaliação (M&A), acompanhar indicadores, analisar dados e propor ajustes para aprimorar a execução e alcançar resultados;
Coordenar e acompanhar a equipe no processo de inserção de dados na plataforma digital de coleta de dados dos projetos (checagem e inserção de fichas de inscrição, apoio e acompanhamento do lançamento de presenças).
GESTÃO ADMINISTRATIVA E ORÇAMENTÁRIA DO PROJETO E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (10%)
Apoiar e organizar processos administrativos do projeto, incluindo documentação, planejamento de atividades, logística de oficinas e treinamentos, interface com áreas internas e prestação de contas;
Manter estreita articulação com os demais departamentos da Empodera (RH, DP, Administrativo e Financeiro), seguindo os fluxos e processos estabelecidos;
Acompanhar a execução orçamentária, garantindo conformidade com o planejamento e normas internas, e reportando ajustes necessários à gestão e coordenação financeira;
Participar de reuniões internas, grupos de trabalho, comitês temáticos e representações externas, fortalecendo a articulação institucional e a troca de conhecimentos;
Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de setores e processos institucionais, fortalecendo a estrutura organizacional e a implementação de boas práticas, com autonomia na execução das tarefas delegadas.

title: LNG Economist
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an LNG Economist to join Strategy & Business Development Division (SBDD) within the Gas Venture Department.
SBDD is responsible for sourcing and developing international gas value chain (upstream, liquefaction, marketing, regasification) investment opportunities. The Division is also responsible for coordinating the execution of these investment opportunities and managing investments post transaction, with an objective of creating a viable, material integrated global gas business by 2035.
Your primary role, as part on the economics modeling team, is to support the commercial business development team who develops the supply side of the LNG business and will lead the economic evaluation of LNG projects in terms of plant investment and offtake trading for investment decision making. Additionally, you will be required to engage with support functions such as Treasury, Group Finance and Strategy & Market Analysis as part of the model sign-off and due diligence process.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Provide analysis of potential joint ventures and mergers and acquisitions primarily in LNG and Upstream opportunities and responsible economic and financial modeling on an unlevered and levered basis
Handle complex deal structures, with the development and interpretation of data used in a highly technical and confidential analysis platform.
Provide sound investment analysis advice in support of LNG and Upstream Projects for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) deals, by leading economic evaluations and financial due diligence in the deal making process
Provide professional and technical expertise for the analysis and solution of complex problems in all areas of financial modeling and economic analysis.
Validate and review of seller's models on opportunities related to Upstream and LNG, identify potential problems and recommend solutions.
Provide analysis to fully understand and articulate economic value drivers to management.
Examine and prepare variance analysis of economic assumptions and high-level technical inputs with functional engagement support.
Provide support in preparation of management presentations for progression of deals through the stage gate process.
Assist in the formulation and implementation of economic analysis, policies and procedures to prevent or resolve problems and follow-up implemented changes to ensure the problem has been resolved.
Ensure that the company standards and processes are reflected in capital projects progression, project evaluations and in analysis of the business and environment through the stage gate process.
Train and develop junior professional analysts
Minimum Requirements
As the successful candidate you will have:
Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or Business. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of related financial modeling work experience, preferably in an investment banking environment or a major petrochemical or energy industry corporation.
You will also have experience with Economic Evaluations, Cash Flow & Variance Analysis, structured finance, project finance and/or financial modeling.
You will be able to conduct Monte-Carlo stochastic risk analysis and VB excel modelling.
You will also be able to quickly establish credibility in the position and to effectively interact with all levels of management, including senior leadership.
You will have the capability to work effectively within a matrix organization and with multi-disciplinary teams.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Com atuação nos segmentos de seguro saúde e odonto, vida e acidentes pessoais, gestão de ativos e previdência privada, a SulAmérica conta com mais de 4 mil pessoas colaboradoras e possui mais de 7 milhões de clientes distribuídos por todo Brasil.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

Se você é uma pessoa qualificada, de perfil inovador e sintonizada com o que há de mais atual em sua área de atuação, junte-se à nossa equipe.

Oferecemos mais que vagas de trabalho, oferecemos oportunidades para você fazer a diferença.

title: Instrumentation Engineer
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer to join our Technical Support Team under Global Manufacturing Organization (GM)
The Technical Support Team is a multi-disciplinary team focusing mainly on supporting the technical and business needs of GM Operating facilities.
Your primary role is to handle instrumentation engineering aspects such as designing, developing, installing, managing, and maintaining instruments systems across multiple Downstream facilities. You will also be responsible for providing technical support on high priority systems issues.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Provide technical guidance, support, training, and expertise to plant departments.
Monitor instrumentation systems performance across all downstream departments.
Assess Instrumentation performance and recommend improvements for system optimization.
Develop and maintain lifecycle management activities for instrumentation systems.
Establish auditing guidelines and perform frequent instruments audits.
Lead the development of new strategies and validate the feasibility of improving company productivity.
Ensure manufacturing knowledge is captured in the knowledge repository and continuous improvement is delivered by benchmarking and best practices.
Provide awareness sessions and lead technical exchanges and conferences.
Maintain Instrumentation systems knowledge repository.
Act as a subject matter expert in Instrumentation and contribute to the troubleshooting activities.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or equivalent.
You will have a minimum of 12 years' experience in refining /oil and gas plants /petrochemical industries.
You will be proficient in the codes and standards in the oil and gas industry, i.e., API, BS, ISO, ASME, ANSI, IEC, ISA, IEEE, etc.
You will have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
You will be Familiar with field instrument types and applications.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Engenheiro (a) de Reservatório Sr
description:
Somos a Brava Energia, a Companhia independente de óleo e gás mais diversificada do Brasil.

Temos operações em terra e mar, do upstream ao downstream, com mais de mil colaboradores em nossa força de trabalho. Oferecemos amplas oportunidades para o desenvolvimento da sua carreira, em um ambiente dinâmico, focado em resultados e alta performance. Estamos constantemente aplicando a experiência do nosso time para maximizar nossa produção, transformando O&G em valor para o Brasil.

Venha crescer com a gente

Missão do cargo:
Conduzir o desenvolvimento e a implementação de estratégias avançadas para otimizar a recuperação de óleo e gás, assegurando a eficiência no desenvolvimento de reservatórios e fornecendo suporte técnico especializado para projetos de alta complexidade e novas oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Aplicar métodos de previsão de comportamento de produção, incluindo DCA (Declination Curve Analysis), Balanço de Materiais e elaboração de poços tipo, focando na precisão de diagnósticos e previsões.
  • Construir modelos de simulação numérica, ajuste de histórico e elaboração de cenários de previsão de produção buscando otimizar o desenvolvimento dos campos Onshore.
  • Conduzir estudos de revitalização de campos maduros, com foco em métodos de recuperação secundária e terciária (Waterflooding e/ou Steamflooding), liderar propostas de novos poços, oportunidades de workover e integrar equipes multidisciplinares (Geologia, Geofísica e Operações).
  • Preparar estimativa, avaliação e classificação de recursos e reservas, aplicando as normas da PRMS.
  • Liderar a elaboração e revisão de entregáveis regulatórios, garantindo o alinhamento técnico e o cumprimento de prazos do BAR (Boletim Anual de Reservas), PAT (Plano Anual de Trabalho), PAP(Plano Anual de Produção) e PD (Plano de Desenvolvimento), além de representar a companhia em demandas técnicas junto à agência.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico, sendo responsável pela formação de novos talentos na área de reservatórios.
  • Liderar a avaliação técnica de novos ativos (New Ventures), construindo cenários probabilísticos robustos que fundamentem avaliações econômicas e decisões de investimento (CAPEX/OPEX).

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Petróleo ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês Avançado.
  • Experiência em Gestão de Campos Maduros e estratégias em soluções de problemas para garantir a maximização dos volumes, reservas e taxas de produção; análise de decisão e risco para quantificar incertezas de engenharia.

title: Analista de Testes
description:
Sobre a Base

Somos a Base Exchange, a futura nova Bolsa de Valores do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro.

Por meio de uma infraestrutura de ponta, desenvolvida em parceria com a Flowa Technologies, a Base visa ampliar o mercado de capitais do país, trazendo mais uma opção para que empresas e investidores façam seus negócios com transparência, agilidade e tecnologia. Buscamos uma constante parceria com nossos clientes, mantendo um relacionamento próximo e pautado pela confiança.

Nosso time é qualificado e movido pelo compromisso incansável com a excelência e inovação. Somos guiados pela tecnologia e foco no cliente, com um espírito inquieto e uma visão transformadora. Buscamos tornar o mercado de capitais mais dinâmico, acessível e conectado, criando oportunidades que impulsionam a mudança e fortalecem a economia.

No seu dia a dia você irá atuar com:
  • Planejamento de testes automatizados e manuais; 
  • Análise de requisitos de negócio; 
  • Especificação de caso de uso; 
  • Criação e execução de cenários de testes, envolvendo documentação de cenários de testes para Órgãos Reguladores, como BACEN, CVM por exemplo; 
  • Execução de testes manuais; 
  • Desenvolvimento de testes automatizados; 
  • Coleta e registro de evidências de bugs; 
  • Um time que segue a metodologia Kanban e conta com a certificação de algoritmos e funcionalidades relacionadas a nossa plataforma de negociação de mercado financeiro. 
O que você precisa:
  • Graduação completa em Eng. Computação, Sistemas de Informação, e/ou áreas afins; 
  • Experiência em todas as fases do Ciclo de Vida de teste de SW; 
  • Sólida experiência em planejamento de testes e execução de testes automatizados; 
  • Técnicas de teste de software e ferramentas de bugtracking; 
  • Experiência em times ágeis.
Serão considerados diferenciais:
  • Conhecimentos de linguagem de programação (C#), Banco de Dados SQL e ferramentas de controle de versão (GIT);
  • Ter experiência como desenvolvedor;
  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência anterior no mercado financeiro;
  • Inglês Avançado.

Se você busca uma oportunidade de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma equipe engajada no propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro brasileiro, vem com a gente

title: Supply Chain Commercial Analyst
description:
What's The Role
Develop commercially competitive contracting & procurement strategies for assigned key spend categories which meets the Business Demand and aligned with the category strategy.
Apply the PTCAM/CMCP process and CP operations practices while focusing on contribution to the business drivers and not compromising on compliance for HSSE&SP, E&C, Code of Conduct, Laws and regulations.
Identify, develop & implement supply chain improvement opportunities, particularly to enable lean sourcing, effective and waste-free requisition-to-pay (RTP) processes.
Proactively identify & understand commercial/procurement needs from internal stakeholders (Shell Business) and collaboratively propose competitive solutions. This may involve constructively challenging the Business Demand &/or Procurement Practices in order to drive value and efficiency for the organization.
Manage Supplier Relationship effectively and collaboratively drive continuous performance improvement via relevant contract key metrics (e.g.: HSSE, Operations, Cost) to ensure effective contractual delivery, value optimization and risk management.
Build and maintain strong network in the market, being fully aware of supplier developments and opportunities coming up in the market.
Manage Key Stake Holder Interfaces, e.g. Category Leads, Contract Holders, Contract Owners, Global Category Team (where applicable) & Suppliers.
What You Bring
Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
Bachelor's degree in related field
At least 5 years of experience in contract supply chain
Oil and gas industry experience preferred
Proven track record of execution excellence & delivering results.
Highly tuned commercial acumen and curiosity with demonstrated ability to develop and deliver value from complex deals.
Proven experience in contract negotiations & complex tender evaluation
Good understanding of strategic, technical, legal, finance, taxation and commercial issues.
Highly driven, 'can do', inspiring, able to articulate in a crisp and precise manner.
Able to translate strategy to tangible and valuable outcomes for the local business
Uncompromising on HSSE, ethics & compliance
Continuous improvement and simplification mindset
Strong and Proven Interpersonal, Influencing & Stakeholder Management Skills.
Ability to cope with complexity & uncertainty and proven adaptability
Driven, Motivated & Passionate to drive positive change.
What We Offer
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You'll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You'll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.
We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world's most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here.
Shell in Brazil
Who We Are
Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.
Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.
Our approach
Shell's strategy is to deliver more value with less emissions as we work to become a net-zero emissions business by 2050.
As we navigate the energy transition through the next decade, we will leverage our global footprint, the trust in our brand, and our innovation and technology capabilities to be the energy company that customers and countries choose to be their partner. We are positioning Shell to become the investment case and partner of choice through the energy transition.
Our values
At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.
As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.
About The Role
We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.
You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.
Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.
Responsibilities
Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.
Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.
Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.
Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.
Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.
Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.
Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.
Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.
Requirements (Must-Haves)
5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels
Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs
Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)
Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)
Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale
Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights
Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Nice to Have
Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea
Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research
Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses
Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok
Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

Please fill it out as honestly and intuitively as possible since it is designed to detect exaggeration, which will cause your application to be automatically rejected. Continuously invest in demonstrable quality and reliability of the system via unit tests, automated integration tests, TDD and refactoring. Keep data management and security in mind at all times to protect customer privacy.

Identify software quality, performance, and operational issues, including impediments to team-wide efficiency and work constructively with the team to address them.   • TDD experience is a plus.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills: Proven ability to build strong relationships with technical and non-technical members of the team to solve challenging technical and business problems.

  • Relentlessly Resourceful ): highly proactive, does not quit, and finds innovative solutions with little guidance. Bias for action and ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment with a high degree of autonomy.

A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Quer melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade e contribuir para chegarmos ainda mais longe? Então, traga o seu talento para a Motiva.
SOBRE A MOTIVA

A Motiva é feita de pessoas interessadas em contribuir para o nosso propósito: melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade.
Somos referência em infraestrutura de mobilidade no Brasil, liderando o setor com foco na criação de valor sustentável e melhorando a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade. Atuamos em serviços de infraestrutura para mobilidade, focados nos segmentos de concessão de rodovias, trilhos e aeroportos.

São mais de 16 mil colaboradores responsáveis pela gestão e manutenção de 4.475km de rodovias, por onde circulam cerca de 2 milhões de veículos, diariamente. Nos trilhos, administramos serviços de transporte de passageiros de metrôs, trens e VLT, transportando diariamente, 3 milhões de passageiros. E no segmento de aeroportos, com 20 terminais sob nossa gestão, atendemos mais de 40 milhões de clientes anualmente.

Para que os clientes possam chegar em segurança nos seus destinos, a Motiva investe em práticas que reforçam o compromisso com o meio ambiente, com o social e com a governança, construindo infraestrutura, implementando serviços e oferecendo oportunidades.

title: IT Support Technician
description:
IT Support Technician

  • Located in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday - Friday

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The IT Support Technician provides basic technical support to the Brazil business unit. This role focuses on assisting with day-to-day IT operations, including troubleshooting hardware and software issues, supporting user access, and maintaining system functionality. The position works under the guidance of senior IT staff and collaborates with local teams to ensure smooth IT operations. The role reports directly to the Director of IT and maintains a functional reporting line to the Operations Manager.

Tasks:

  1. Perform basic troubleshooting with the ability to resolve common hardware and software issues for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices.
  2. Provide user support by assisting with password resets, account lockouts, and VPN connectivity issues.
  3. Monitor system performance and report issues to senior IT staff and via applicable Remedy Ticket Systems.
  4. Assist with software installations and updates of standard applications under supervision.
  5. Provide inventory & setup by preparing new workstations and ensuring proper configuration.
  6. Maintain records of support requests and resolutions.
  7. Perform simple maintenance tasks like cleaning equipment and checking cables.

Skills:

  • Proficient oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (IP addresses, Wi-Fi setup).
  • Ability to follow instructions and escalate complex issues.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This role does not include supervisory responsibilities.

Work Environment:

This position is based in a professional office setting and involves regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones. Additionally, the role may occasionally require interaction with enterprise-grade IT and infrastructure systems such as firewalls, network switches, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and both copper and fiber optic network cabling under the supervision of Senior IT staff.

Physical Demands:

This is an active, hands-on role that requires the IT Support Technician to spend a significant portion of the day standing and moving. The position may involve short bursts of physically demanding activity, such as lifting and relocating computer equipment or navigating stairs. On occasion, tasks may require working in confined or elevated spaces, including under raised computer room floors or above drop ceilings.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time role, and as such, the IT Support Technician is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program available to Katalyst employees.

Core working hours are Monday through Friday, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional hours, including occasional night, weekend, and holiday work, may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and support operational needs.

Travel:

Occasional travel may be necessary. Mileage for offsite meetings or errands will be reimbursed at the current regional rate. Travel will mostly be within the Rio De Janeiro area visiting client and 3
rd
 party sites to service our equipment located at those sites.

Required Education and Experience

  • Certificate of Completion of Secondary Education
  • IT-related coursework, professional training, or industry certifications preferred.
  • Experience of up to 2 years in IT support, system administration, or networking (including internships or technical school experience).
  • Working proficiency in English.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

None required.

Other Duties:

Please note, this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employer for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Responsabilidades Principais

Preparação de Bebidas: Preparar e servir bebidas, desde clássicos da coquetelaria até criações exclusivas, seguindo receitas padronizadas ou personalizando conforme a preferência do cliente.

Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber os clientes de forma simpática e atenciosa, sugerir bebidas do cardápio e garantir um serviço de qualidade, promovendo um ambiente acolhedor e de entretenimento.

Organização e Limpeza: Manter o balcão e a área de trabalho (praça) limpos e organizados antes, durante e após o expediente, garantindo a higiene e a eficiência do serviço.

Gestão de Estoque: Realizar a requisição de insumos (bebidas, frutas, gelo, xaropes, etc.), controlar o inventário e evitar desperdícios, comunicando-se frequentemente com os responsáveis pelas compras.

Manuseio de Equipamentos: Utilizar corretamente e higienizar utensílios e equipamentos de bar, como coqueteleiras, liquidificadores, dosadores e máquinas de gelo.

Segurança e Normas: Seguir as normas de segurança alimentar e de higiene, além de verificar a idade legal dos clientes para o consumo de álcool.

Competências e Habilidades Necessárias

Habilidades Técnicas em Coquetelaria: Conhecimento profundo de receitas de drinks clássicos e contemporâneos, técnicas de preparo (como shaking, stirring, layering) e mixologia.

Comunicação e Interação Social: Excelentes habilidades interpessoais para interagir com os clientes, criar um relacionamento e entender suas necessidades, o que é crucial para a experiência do cliente.

Organização e Agilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão em horários de pico, multitarefa e manter a eficiência e a qualidade no serviço, organizando o fluxo de trabalho.

Paixão pela Profissão: Gostar do que faz, pois o ambiente de trabalho frequentemente envolve horários noturnos e um ritmo dinâmico.

Proatividade e Aprendizado Contínuo: Buscar aprimoramento constante através de cursos, workshops e aprendizado sobre novas tendências e produtos do mercado (vinhos, cervejas, destilados).

Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com outros funcionários do bar, cozinha e salão para garantir um serviço harmonioso e eficiente.

  • Seguro de vida
