title: OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
description:
The
OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect
is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.
  • Design secure and scalable network architectures for OT environments, including SCADA, ICS, and IoT systems.
  • Ensure OT security strategies align seamlessly with corporate IT and cybersecurity policies, while also adhering to industry standards, including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001.
  • Implement and supervise cybersecurity tools, including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and vulnerability scanners, in OT environments.
  • Monitor and respond to OT security incidents, collaborating with incident response teams.
  • Collaborate with GRC team to address regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with engineering, operations, and IT teams to integrate security into the lifecycle of OT assets.
  • Provide cybersecurity training and awareness programs for staff working with OT systems.
  • Engage with external vendors and partners to ensure secure deployment of third-party OT solutions.
  • Stay updated on emerging cybersecurity threats, trends, and technologies relevant to OT environments.
  • Develop and implement strategies for continuous improvement of OT cybersecurity posture.
  • Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives for new cybersecurity technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCES

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with at least 2 years focusing on OT environments (e.g., SCADA, ICS).
  • Deep knowledge of OT systems and protocols, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and MQTT.
  • Proficiency with cybersecurity frameworks like IEC 62443, NIST CSF, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS.
  • Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and endpoint protection in OT environments.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles (e.g., VLANs, VPNs, routing).
  • Experience in renewable energy or other critical infrastructure industries is a plus.
  • CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent certifications preferred.
  • Proficiency both in Portuguese and English.
  • Availability for international travels.

KEY SKILLS

  • Strategic vision
  • Problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in building relationships with internal and external partners to drive cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Resilient
  • Strong attention to detail to ensure precision in designing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity measures.
  • Flexibility to respond to evolving cybersecurity threats and technological advancements.

title: Analista de Risco
description:

Fundada em 2010, a SPX Capital é uma das maiores gestoras de recursos independentes do Brasil, com cerca de R$ 58 bilhões em ativos sob gestão e 260 profissionais distribuídos nos escritórios de Londres, Nova York, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Cascais e Singapura.

Oferecendo estratégias de Multimercado Macro, Ações, Crédito, Real Estate e Private Equity, a SPX Capital possui gestores experientes, com histórico de resultados de sucesso, combinando capital humano de alta qualidade, processos robustos e valores éticos, construindo assim um negócio dinâmico para o longo prazo.

  • Monitoramento diário de VaR, Stress e volatilidade das carteiras;

  • Implementar ferramentas de Data Science voltadas para a modernização dos processos de gestão de risco.

Rio de Janeiro

A SPX acredita que a diversidade gera importantes benefícios organizacionais em qualquer equipe e permite que as diferenças sejam transformadas em oportunidades, assegurando condições de pleno desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais e gerando retorno para a sociedade. title: Associate - Global Mobility Services - Immigration
description:
Vialto Partners is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to 'Connect the world'. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.

Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 6,500 staff in over 50 countries around the world, and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry. You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram.

Job Description
As a Senior Associate, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive tax and consulting experience, helping our clients meet their individual income tax compliance obligations. You will address complex tax issues from strategy to execution, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. Building trusted relationships and fostering team success are essential parts of this role.

Responsibilities for this position include but are not limited to:

  • Assist clients in their individual income tax compliance obligations, including preparation of individual income tax computations and returns, and handling correspondence with the respective tax authorities.
  • Act to resolve issues which prevent effective team working, even during times of change and uncertainty.
  • Coach others and encourage them to take ownership of their development.
  • Analyze complex ideas or proposals and build a range of meaningful recommendations.
  • Address sub-standard work or work that does not meet company's/client's expectations.
  • Develop a perspective on key global trends, including globalization, and how they impact the company and our clients.
  • Manage a variety of viewpoints to build consensus and create positive outcomes for all parties.
  • Focus on building trusted relationships.
  • Uphold the company's code of ethics and business conduct.

Qualifications

  • An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
  • A demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing and coaching diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard.
  • Experience in expatriate tax; knowledge in Taiwan personal income tax represents an advantage.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience for senior position.
  • Candidates with less experience will be considered for the position of associates.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple assignments, clients and staff.
  • Strong analytical, organization and communication skills.
  • An ability to work effectively under pressure and a proactive attitude.
  • Fluent in Portuguese.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Education/ Graduation: Business, Law, Economy, International Relations.
  • Demonstrated business development skills and enthusiasm about contributing to the growth of the Global Mobility Services practice.

title: Analista de Suporte ao Campo
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

 Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. 

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.  

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. 

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. 

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. 

O time de Logística:


A Logística é um ponto-chave na nossa missão de encantar o(a) cliente. Afinal, para atingir o objetivo de transformar o mercado de meios de pagamento, é preciso pensar em cada detalhe.

Nossa missão é garantir o melhor e mais rápido atendimento do país. Para atingir esse objetivo, nossa área é responsável por atuar em toda cadeia logística (Supply, Sistemas, Last Mile, Gente e Segurança), colocando a mão na massa desde as compras das maquininhas até a sua efetiva entrega para nossos(as) clientes. 

Conheça um pouco mais do time de Logística no Nosso Manifesto.

Como é ser um(a) Analista de Suporte ao Campo | Logística:


O time da Central da Logística é responsável por suportar o time de campo de toda a operação que temos no país, fornecendo o suporte necessário, em forma de atendimento, aos operadores logísticos antes, durante e após o atendimento ao(à) cliente.

As principais atividades são:

  • Rotina diária de atendimento pelos canais de whatsapp e CRM, dando suporte aos(as) operadores(as) de campo, que realizam a entrega dos nossos equipamentos.
  • Interface com o(a) cliente, solucionando seus problemas;
  • Mapear as demandas de atendimento;
  • Realizar registro do atendimento;
  • Saber informar os fluxos ou direcionar o canal correto.

O que esperamos de você: 

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Possuir superior completo ou estar cursando Administração, Economia, Engenharias, Logística ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos sábados e domingos (escala).

O que aumenta as suas chances:

  • Experiência em suporte técnico ao campo;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel/SQL;
  • Capacidade analítica;
  • Boa comunicação.

title: Payroll and Benefits Officer
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • Responsible for preparing and registering all benefits in payroll systems in a timely and qualitive manner, in line with group procedures, internal control and local laws.
  • Understand the payroll system of your country as well as interface with HRIS and accounting systems.
  • Responsible for the Time Off administration: absences, sickness, maternity, paternity, work accident.
  • Responsible for reporting any issue to the PandB specialist or to the PandB manager (HRIS reporting, accounting problem, payroll software problem)

    • Responsibilities


  • Collect the payroll elements on a monthly basis
  • Process them in the payroll software
  • In charge of the reconciliation on monthly/quarterly/annual basis of all ledger accounts impacted by the payroll
  • Prepare all wage taxes instructions and payments for Payroll management and local Management to approve
  • Prepare all the documents for Payroll management check and Management approval on a monthly basis
  • Prepare the payroll audit documents and gather all audits documents requested from HR Admin part
  • Ensure a smooth communication is in place with the Payroll Manager
  • Collaborate and build relationships with International mobility specialists, HRIS team, HR admin to ensure of the accuracy of all payroll benefits and contractual information
  • Responsible for payment to third parties (pension, medical coverage, unemployment insurance…)
  • Prepare HeadCount reporting
  • Act as focal point for all absence registration and reporting
  • In charge of the Time Off accuracy and support to employees / HR community
  • Request payroll and CandB related purchase orders
  • ensure follow up with any third party when necessary
  • support closely the employees in their understanding of the benefits and payslips
  • Respond to payrollrelated inquiries and resolve concerns (tickets in Service Now) when these concerns are specific to countries

    • Education


  • HR degree or related areas.
  • Intermediate English.
  • Fluent in local language for officers in countries.
  • Knowledge of a local legislation is a must.
  • Good level in excel.

    • Experience


  • Good knowledge on payroll activities: regular tasks, registration
  • Good communication skills
  • Experience with payrolling
  • Knowledge of current payroll software is a must
  • Analytical and reporting skills
  • Confidentiality skill
  • Team spirit

    • Functional Competencies


    Tools and data governance Diversity and inclusion Analytics and reporting Payroll Labour law Change Management Personnel administration
